fields.why: Age and perceived gender appear only in the list of fields on the reporting form, and 'demographics' only in a limitation; no age bound or analysis uses them. Empty is the stricter reading, but age/sex as descriptors (limitation rule) is defensible, and the level is 0 either way.

The article says nothing about nonindependence, and formulation was assigned by troop (3 of 11), so persons are clustered; 'none' needs independent units or a model that plainly has nothing to account for (V11).

brief_issues: Whether variables listed only as fields a reporting form collects (age, perceived gender), and never analyzed, are recorded as descriptor dimensions is not settled.
